name: Stair Spikes
disable: DC 22 Thievery check (trained) to unhook the pressure plate or DC 24 Crafting check (trained) to block the spikes

items.name: Look Sharp
items.text:
Trigger The door is opened while someone is standing on the stairs

---
Effect Spikes fire upward, dealing 2d8+5 piercing damage to all creatures standing on the landing or stairs (DC 25 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, the creature takes a –5 status penalty to its Speed for 1 hour; on a critical failure it's also Clumsy 1.

text: A set of Hidden spikes stabs into the feet of anyone on the landing or front stairs.
